identities.title: Linked accounts
identities.description: Accounts at sign-in providers you can sign in here with.
identities.unlinkText: You can no longer sign in with {{name}} until you link the account again.
identities.linked: Your account at {{name}} is linked now.

oidcAdmin.title: Sign-in
oidcAdmin.description: Sign-in through OpenID Connect providers such as Google, optionally with self-registration for allowed domains.
oidcAdmin.empty: No provider set up yet. People sign in with a password.
oidcAdmin.checkOk: Discovery and keys can be reached.
oidcAdmin.deleteText: {{name}} is deleted with every person's link to it. Whoever signed in only this way then needs a password.
oidcAdmin.callbackHint: Enter it at the provider as an allowed redirect URI.
oidcAdmin.callbackMissing: Without HERD_PUBLIC_URL there is no callback address; the provider cannot be switched on.

form.googleHint: Create an OAuth client ID of type web application in the Google Cloud Console and enter its client ID and secret. The callback address appears once saved.
form.genericHint: The provider must support OpenID Connect Discovery.
form.keyHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; part of the callback address.
form.name: Name
form.secretValueHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.trustEmailHint: Only switch it on if the provider is authoritative for every verified address (your own company directory, say, where nobody changes their own address); the first sign-in then links an existing account with the same address. Self-registration needs this setting.
form.allowSignupHint: New people from the allowed domains can register. Their account waits for approval under People → Awaiting approval; only then can they sign in, as members without AI. With a generic provider only together with “Trust this provider's email addresses”.
form.domainsHint: One domain per line, exactly (no subdomains).
form.domainsRequired: Self-registration needs at least one domain.
form.signupNeedsTrust: Self-registration is only possible if you trust this provider's email addresses.
form.editHint: The stored secret is never shown; keep it or replace it.

oidc.not_found: This provider does not exist (any more).
oidc.preset_fixed: Google's issuer and scopes are fixed.
oidc.fields_required: Key, name and issuer are required.
oidc.url_not_allowed: This address is not allowed (https only, no private addresses unless allowed).
oidc.domains_required: Self-registration needs at least one domain.
oidc.signup_needs_trust: Self-registration through a generic provider is only possible if you trust its email addresses.
oidc.domain_invalid: A domain is not valid (no wildcards, no trailing dot).
oidc.public_url_missing: HERD_PUBLIC_URL is not set; no provider can be switched on without it.
oidc.version_conflict: Someone changed the provider in the meantime.
oidc.last_identity: This is the account's last way to sign in. Set a password first.
oidc.identity_not_found: This link does not exist (any more).
oidc.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
oidc.secret_unavailable: The client secret cannot be read (variable missing or wrong key).
oidc.issuer_mismatch: The discovery document names another issuer.

users.not_pending: This account has already been decided on.
users.awaiting_approval: This account is awaiting approval. Approve it instead of reactivating it.

pending.hint: These people registered themselves through a sign-in provider. They cannot sign in until you approve them; until then they have no access. Approved accounts start as members without AI.

approve.title: Approve account?
approve.text: {{name}} can then sign in as a member (without AI until you assign otherwise under AI).

reject.title: Reject account?
reject.text: The account of {{name}} is deleted, with everything registering created. The address is free again: the person can register anew, or you add them yourself.

signup.decided: {{name}} registered; the approval has been decided.
